title: Railroad Crossing Repair
description: Use this service request to report concerns regarding railroad crossings in need of repair - i.e. rough railroad crossings. Call 9-1-1 for malfunctioning railroad signals. Contact DART for DART train/rail crossings. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 7 business days. **** Please be advised that the City of Dallas does not have jurisdiction over maintenance of railroads. They are owned, operated and maintained by the rail/railroad owner and notified accordingly. ****

observedQuestions.question: Is the repair for rough or unrepaired railroad track/grade crossings?

conditionalPaths.instruction: Uh oh, if this is regarding malfunctioning railroad arms or if a train is blocking the crossing - Call 9-1-1. For DART rail crossings - please contact DART.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a rough railroad crossing.
actions.why: Report a rough or unrepaired railroad track or grade crossing. The 311 request form asks whether the concern is a rough or unrepaired crossing.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Railroad Crossing Repair" requests does not apply to malfunctioning railroad signals or arms, a train blocking the crossing, or DART train/rail crossings. If railroad signals or arms are malfunctioning, then call 911. If a train is blocking the crossing, then call 911. If the crossing is for DART rail, then contact DART.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Railroad Crossing Repair"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Railroad Crossing Repair"

actions.tagline: Call 911 about malfunctioning railroad signals or crossing arms.
actions.why: For malfunctioning railroad signals or crossing arms. The description and 311 request form for "Railroad Crossing Repair" requests on the Dallas 311 website direct these concerns to 911.

actions.tagline: Contact DART Customer Support about a DART rail crossing.
actions.why: For a nonurgent repair concern at a DART train or rail crossing. The description for "Railroad Crossing Repair" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs DART rail crossing concerns to DART.
actions.why_not: DART Customer Support is not the route for an urgent railroad-crossing malfunction or a train blocking the crossing. If signals or arms malfunction or a train blocks the crossing, then call 911.
actions.how: Call 214-749-3333 or use the DART Contact Us page
actions.how_formatted: Call [214-749-3333](tel:2147493333) or use the [DART Contact Us page](https://www.dart.org/contact-us)

actions.tagline: Call 911 about a train blocking a railroad crossing.
actions.why: For a train blocking a railroad crossing. The 311 request form for "Railroad Crossing Repair" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs this situation to 911.
